args.code: (() => { const items = document.querySelectorAll('.sell-item, .crop-item, .shop-item, .product-item'); let result = []; for (let item of items) { const nameEl = item.querySelector('.item-name, .product-name, h3, h4, .name'); const name = nameEl ? nameEl.textContent.trim() : ''; if (name) { result.push(name); } } if (result.length === 0) { const all = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (let el of all) { const text = el.textContent.trim(); if (text && text.length < 50 && text.length > 2 && (text.includes('水稻') || text.includes('红薯') || text.includes('小麦') || text.includes('玉米') || text.includes('大豆') || text.includes('土豆') || text.includes('花生') || text.includes('辣椒') || text.includes('茄子') || text.includes('白菜') || text.includes('萝卜') || text.includes('大蒜'))) { result.push(text); } } } return JSON.stringify([...new Set(result)].slice(0, 30)); })()
